name: AC1.2 needed-by is read back as the weekday and time the backend resolved
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say in one sentence: you need two tri-axle dump trucks at the Route 104 job tomorrow at seven. Answer any question briefly and truthfully with those facts. When the assistant reads the details back and asks whether to submit, say yes. After it gives you a reference number, say that's all and goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent calls resolve_needed_by with the caller's words for when (tomorrow at seven) before reading the details back.
In the read-back before submitting, the agent states the needed-by as Monday (the weekday), November 2, at 7 AM, as resolve_needed_by returned it.
In the read-back the agent does not use the word 'tomorrow' for the needed-by.
The agent never says the request is confirmed, never states availability, and never gives an arrival time.
